description: Every Peekaboo deal, branch, and bank-card offer from the terminal — plus city-wide deal ranking, bank-card reverse lookup, and bulk branch map-link export the Peekaboo site has no button for.

novel_features.name: Branch directions URLs
novel_features.description: Get a ready-to-open Google Maps directions link for every branch of a restaurant at once.

novel_features.name: Nearest branch
novel_features.description: Find the single closest branch of a restaurant to a city or coordinates, with its directions link.

novel_features.name: Card to merchants
novel_features.description: List every merchant in a city that honors a given bank card's deal (card to merchants).

novel_features.name: Top deals ranking
novel_features.description: Rank a city's merchants by discount percentage and return the biggest current discounts.

novel_features.name: Expiring deals
novel_features.description: List deals whose validity window closes within N days.

novel_features.name: Open now
novel_features.description: Keep only merchants with a branch open at the current local time.
